step_6_sfx.purpose: Slider click (1 SFX at ~2.5s timing) + magnetic snap (1 SFX at ~4.5s timing)

step_7_mix.operation: Mix music bed (low level, -18dB) + SFX (peak level, -6dB) + video (no native audio)

step_8_score.purpose: Score the final mixed asset for hook strength, retention, virality potential
